title: Siege of Buda (1541)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Buda (1541)", at revision 1373785650, opens: "The siege of Buda ended with the capture of the city of Buda, the historical capital of the Kingdom of Hungary, by the Ottoman Empire, leading to about 150 years of Ottoman rule in parts of Hungary. The siege, part of the Little War in Hungary, was one of the most important Ottoman victories over the Habsburg monarchy during Ottoman–Habsburg wars in Hungary and the Balkans." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q604587, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1541 siege of Buda by troops of Ferdinand I". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
